# We take our own  security seriously

Due to the sensitivity of the data stored in Aikido, security on our own platform is our highest priority.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/6623c6bb247fd19740a15095_GDPR.svg)

### Privacy & GDPR

Aikido is in full compliance of the

General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

[Learn more](https://trustcenter.aikido.dev/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/662917ff4a761cf00c9d5ef7_734f87ad6da1f29eddbb295a1378d106_icon-logo-%28iso%2Baicpa%29.svg)![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/694bb1c0ec4021bcd5dcbd01_FR.png)

### Compliance

Aikido is ISO 27001:2022, ISO 42001 & AICPA's SOC 2 Type II compliant, and FedRAMP Certified: Class C (Moderate).

[Request Certificates](https://trustcenter.aikido.dev/resources)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/667d977c9fe312379ebdfbf5_pentesting.svg)

### Pentesting & Bug Bounties

Aikido conducts annual external

pentests and maintains an active

bug bounty program.

Message help@aikido.dev with your Intigriti

username to get invited to the bug bounty program.

[Request Bug Bounty Access](mailto:help@aikido.dev?subject=Bugbounty%20programme%20access%20request)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/6acf7ab7b06811780eb0747e_CREST-colour.png)![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/6acf7ab78ebd110555964eed_CREST-pentest.png)

### CREST Member

Aikido is CREST accredited for penetration testing. Our human-led pentests follow processes CREST has independently reviewed.

[View our CREST listing](https://marketplace.crest.org/supplier/aikido-security/)

## Aikido

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/6624ce2082c0a13c9adb6511_Icon.webp)

## never stores your code.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/642adcaf364024a62571df4f_Down.svg)

## Aikido    doesn't    store    your    code    after    completing    the    analysis.    We    perform    actions    such    as    git    clones    in    a    fresh    docker    container    for    each    repository.    After    analysis,    the    data    is    wiped    and            the    docker    container    is    terminated.

![Aikido process](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/661d2304a3b6ffa44875c8e4_process.webp)

![github](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/6624d4fff7fb408af8558ca8_github.svg)

### Online scanning

For GitHub, no refresh or access tokens are stored in our database. An Aikido database breach would not result in your GitHub code being downloadable. By default, our integrations require a read-only scope.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/6624d5c5f7fb408af856358e_scanners.svg)

### Local scanning

Alternatively, you can run Aikido locally (on-prem) as well. Download the Aikido [local scanners](https://help.aikido.dev/doc/setting-up-local-scanner-in-github-actions/docn4KpccwdF) to get started.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Can I try Aikido without giving access to my own code?

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/677e7ee83e1d2582b3a8a8b6_Down.svg)

Yes - you can connect a real repo (read-only access), or use our public demo project to explore the platform. All scans are read-only and Aikido never makes changes to your code. Fixes are proposed via pull requests you review and merge.

What happens to my data?

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/677e7ee83e1d2582b3a8a8b6_Down.svg)

We clone your repositories into short-lived, isolated environments created just for your scans. These environments exist only for the duration of the analysis, which usually completes in one to five minutes. Once the scan finishes, every clone and container is automatically removed.

Does Aikido make changes to my codebase?

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/677e7ee83e1d2582b3a8a8b6_Down.svg)

We can’t & won’t, this is [guaranteed by read-only access](https://help.aikido.dev/general-information/aikido-never-stores-your-code).

What do you do with my source code?

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/677e7ee83e1d2582b3a8a8b6_Down.svg)

Aikido does not store your code after an analysis. Some analyses, such as SAST and Secrets Detection, require a git clone operation. More detailed information can be found on [help.aikido.dev](https://help.aikido.dev/general-information/aikido-never-stores-your-code).

How can I trust Aikido?

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/677e7ee83e1d2582b3a8a8b6_Down.svg)

We’re doing everything we can to be fully secure & compliant. Aikido has been examined to attest that its system and the suitability of the design of controls meets the AICPA's SOC 2 Type II & ISO 27001:2022 requirements. Find out more on our [Trust Center](https://www.aikido.dev/trust-center).

Does Aikido require agents?

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/677e7ee83e1d2582b3a8a8b6_Down.svg)

The core platform is API-based, so you are up and running in minutes. This also makes Aikido less intrusive. We use an on-device agent for Device Protection, our endpoint security tool.

‍

‍

Do you have a bug bounty program?

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/677e7ee83e1d2582b3a8a8b6_Down.svg)

Yes we do! You can find our bug bounty programs on [Intigriti](https://app.intigriti.com/programs/aikido/aikido/detail).

Availability

## Aikido is available on any device, worldwide.

Health checks & simple pings of the components are used to check if the functions are operational.

[Open Status Page](https://status.aikido.dev/)

Release process

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/642adcaf3640247e7871e038_Down.svg)

1

Integration and automatic end2end testing in CI ensures that updates do not break any use cases required by users.

2

Changes are communicated to the customer success team in a timely manner.

3

Test environments can freely be created upon request.

4

Changes are communicated to end users in-app.

5

There is no beta environment that contains newer features. Experimental features are released by feature flagging.

Responsible Disclosure Policy

## At Aikido, we consider the security of our systems a top priority. But no matter how much effort we put into system security, there can still be vulnerabilities present.

If you discover a security vulnerability, we would like to know about it so we can take steps to address it as quickly as possible.

[hello@aikido.dev](mailto:hello@aikido.dev)
